zh-CN.title: 科研任务与汇报协作
items: 科研概览聚焦成员、里程碑与介绍，任务支持单一汇报周期和自动待办
汇报与讨论支持二级回复、成员和日期组合筛选，答复请求在实际回复后自动完成
科研奖励支持报告自动发放、评论 BONUS 编辑与来源跳转，日报可记录 AI 与思考工时
报销支持日期区间、多项目凭证和外币中行折算价，金额统一保留两位小数
日期统一使用连续月历，优化科研按钮与手机弹层层级，移除任务资源入口

en.title: Research tasks and reporting
items: Focused research overviews, one reporting frequency per task and automatic to-dos
Threaded discussions with member/date filters and requests completed by actual replies
Automatic report rewards, editable comment bonuses and source links, plus AI/thinking work durations
Itemized reimbursements with date ranges, evidence and foreign-currency BOC quotes, rounded to two decimals
Shared scrolling calendars, compact research controls and corrected mobile overlay ordering; task resource entries removed
